subject: math
description: Apply triangle congruence postulates and theorems, including SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and HL, while avoiding invalid shortcuts such as SSA and AAA.
learningObjectives: Identify corresponding sides and angles in two triangles
Apply SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, and HL when enough congruence evidence is given
Distinguish valid triangle congruence reasons from invalid shortcuts such as SSA and AAA
Decide when the HL theorem applies to right triangles
Write complete triangle congruence statements using correct vertex order
prerequisites: Name triangles and corresponding parts accurately
Use angle and segment congruence markings in diagrams
Recognize right angles and hypotenuses in right triangles
Understand that congruent figures have the same size and shape
Use geometric notation such as △ABC and ∠A
